item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-29 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 11 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (5). Check Point has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2021-44026 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 413 positions.
